Wanted to build a homelab/home server but didn't know where to start? So did I, so i spent the last YEAR documenting and learning EVERYTHING about Homelabbing,  including what to buy for homelabbing, how to get started with a home server for beginners, and put it all into one LONGGGGG video just for you. :) 

Support the Channel! Pls rent is so expensive omg: https://patreon.com/dammit_jeff
CHECK OUT THE SECOND CHANNEL AHHH @DangitJeff 

0:00 - What is Homelabbing?
2:49 - What do you even buy?
12:42 - Software for Homelabbing
16:57 - Storage
21:19 - How apps work
22:48 - Replace Google Photos/iCloud
27:07 - Video Game Selfhosted Apps
33:41 - Movies and TV
40:29 - How do I access my server outside?
43:46 - Tech IS Political

Heads up! If you use any of the links in my description, I may get a small commission if you purchase something. But! It won't be at any extra cost to you, and it's a great way to support the channel! :)

Cheap refurbished Office PC’s: https://ebay.us/BnzyvV
External USB Drive: https://amzn.to/3OG9qTo
Western Digital RED NAS Drives: https://amzn.to/4tZiS4i

*Mini PCs:*
GMKTec (MY PICK it has faster ethernet): https://amzn.to/4aKGZwk
Cheaper Beelink: https://amzn.to/4aW78Xx

Orico DAS: https://amzn.to/40CNVWa

UGREEN NAS: https://nas.us.ugreen.com/Ym3JG0
UPS Battery backup: https://amzn.to/3OyuNGi

*Software Stuff!*
ZimaOS: https://www.zimaspace.com/zimaos
RAID Calculator to see how much storage you’ll have: https://nas.ugreen.com/pages/raid-calculator
Immich (Photos): https://immich.app
Request your Apple iCloud Data here: https://privacy.apple.com
Request your Google Data here: https://takeout.google.com

*Video Game Stuff:*
Rom M: https://romm.app
RetroRom (MY PICK!): https://github.com/JMBeresford/retrom

AMP Server manager: https://cubecoders.com/AMP

DOWNLOAD FIRESHARE!! I WORKED ON THIS AHHH: https://github.com/ShaneIsrael/fireshare
